profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary:
Taleen graduated from Stevens Institute of Technology in May 2020 with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with minors in Cybersecurity and Economics.

Programming Skills:
Java
Python
Kotlin
Javascript (Angular & React)
C++
SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Full stack developer for internal business-to-business (B2B) applications
- Led production support for our team's internal web application
- Developed APIs to connect to internal databases

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with a team of engineers to build and deploy a scalable ML voice assistant from the
ground up for internal web applications within American Express
• Developed the speech-to-text functionalities of the assistant to respond to voice commands
• Successfully developed API functions to connect to Natural Language
Processing algorithms

positions.title: IT Security Intern
positions.description:
• Increased security of confidential information across The Claremont Colleges by implementing Duo multi-factor authentication
• Contributed to security awareness campaign by creating a website to be used for students, faculty, and staff across The Claremont Colleges
• Supported the development of security protocols and procedures in the event of a breach

volunteerExperiences.role: Macys Thanksgiving Day Parade Inflation & Vehicle Team

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteer for events for the office of Hoboken Cultural Affairs. Block captain for Hoboken Arts & Music festivals since 2017. Helped volunteer for other events such the Harvest Festival, Spaghetti Block Party, Sinatra Sing-Off, & Artisan Market.

projects.title: Blockchain digital wallet
projects.description:
• Created a form of cryptocurrency with a group of students to be used for
educational purposes
• Coded a website using HTML to be integrated with blockchain, including
buying, selling, and transferring coins
